_comment: Functions Ghidra's export missed, recovered by hand. build.sh merges these into
work/functions.json before translating, so a fresh Ghidra run cannot silently lose them.
An entry is skipped automatically if a later export does find the function.
Same shape as ghidra/export.sh's output; 'why' is ignored by the translator.

functions.name: FUN_0060fb00
why: 0x0060fb00, 176 bytes. Without this the game aborts before its first frame:
'guest trap at 0060fb00: indirect call to unknown function', from the direct calls at
0x00612b99 and 0x00612dca. __thiscall, no stack args, always returns 1; a four-case switch
on [[this+0xc]+0x48] that publishes display config into the globals at 0x9e454c..0x9e4580,
called right after the IDirect3D8::CheckDeviceType probing in FUN_0060fbc0 and right before
Ghidra gave up at 'jmp dword ptr [eax*4 + 0x60fbb0]' -- a jump table it could not resolve,
sitting in the 16 bytes between this function's last ret and FUN_0060fbc0. The translator
recovers that table itself (translator/x86toc.py:350-351), so only the entry is needed.
x86toc.py's own gap recovery could not find it either: it promotes direct call targets seen
inside KNOWN function ranges (x86toc.py:1321-1328), and both call sites are themselves in
